title: English Practice Quiz 0981
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Because I was tired, I went to bed early.
Because I tired, went bed early.
I because was tired bed early.
Because tired I went early bed.
questions.explanation: The subordinate clause beginning with because explains the reason.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.
